title: A Poisson--Poincaré--Dulac for Poisson Connections
summary: We study Poisson-flat connections with logarithmic poles along a simple normal crossings divisor on a holomorphic Poisson manifold, where flatness is required only along the symplectic foliation. After identifying the relevant logarithmic cotangent Poisson Lie algebroid, we define an Euler--Poisson principal part and a residue theory adapted to the canonical logarithmic Hamiltonian generators.
